description: This file defines a Java class MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages by passing only the message content to the next LogNode in the chain, omitting metadata such as tags, priorities, and exceptions. This is useful for simplified or on-screen logging displays.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only include the message content when passing logs along the chain.

methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.
